observations: Vintage sewing machine on a wooden treadle cabinet with foldable side panel
Cream-colored machine head with visible chipped paint and wear on the right side
Brand name 'SINGER' readable on the front of the machine head in multiple photos
Cast iron treadle base with foot pedal and drive wheel visible
Red/brown wooden table surface with yellow trim strip
Watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI' and 'ADERIBIGBE' across images

claims.evidence: Photos show chipped paint and wear on the machine head; mechanical function cannot be tested remotely.

risks.risk: Machine may not stitch or the treadle mechanism may be seized or broken.
risks.proof: Video of the machine being treadled and stitching a piece of fabric.

risks.risk: Missing accessories such as bobbin, needle, presser foot, or drive belt.
risks.proof: Close-up photo showing all included accessories and the drive belt in place.

risks.risk: Cracks or damage to the wooden table, treadle legs, or cast iron base.
risks.proof: Close-up inspection of table joints, treadle legs, and base casting.

proof_requests: Video of the sewing machine being treadled and stitching fabric
Close-up photos of accessories (bobbin, needle, presser foot) and drive belt
Close-up of the serial number plate for exact model identification
response.reason: The item is identifiable as a Singer treadle sewing machine from the photos; visible wear means it cannot be assumed perfect, so it is priced at worst case as non-working and incomplete pending proof.
